lines.text: Many learners say: Eventually I will call you.
Better: Maybe I will call you.
Eventually means after a long time.
Maybe! Maybe I will call you.

data.why: Eventually means after a long time.

quiz.stem: ___ I will call you, but I am not sure.

en.hook: Do you get “eventuell” wrong in English?
en.caption: “Eventually” means schließlich in German, not eventuell. Wrong: “Eventually I will call you.” Right: “Maybe I will call you.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
